shown.message:
PR #10 is still waiting on review; venue-repo's hold on length is fixed and I've asked all four owners to re-review the new commit.

venue-repo had requested changes because the built PDF ran two lines past page 9. I cut the Code and data paragraph to two lines, shortened two Discussion sentences, and moved the MTEB commit hash to Appendix A. The system-built PDF (`dev`, built from 49b3ebf) now ends the main text on page 9, with References starting on page 10.

The new commit is on `dev` and on `candidate-olb`. I commented on `paper-repo`#9 and re-requested review from venue-repo, figtab-repo, idea-repo and experiment-repo.

Until the owners approve PR #10, I'm not merging it or opening the `main`→`release` and `release`→`final` PRs. The `code/README.md` table-numbering mismatch (Table 1 against the paper's Table 2) is still unraised with experiment-repo.
